description: Per-org metadata for a principal-local org subscription. Lives on disk as `<orgs_root>/<alias>/org.md` — YAML frontmatter for the typed fields, markdown body for principal-editable prose. Same shape as `tech.equanimi.secretariat.channelDef`. Carries the alias (filesystem-local handle for this org), optional canonical DID (`did:web:<host>` typically), human-readable name, and free-form description. Distinct from the signed-envelope `tech.equanimi.secretariat.orgDoc` record which carries the wire-shared, relay-published org definition (channels list, roster, serviceEndpoint) — `org.md` is the principal's local editorial view of the org; the signed `orgDoc` (shipping with federation) is the org's own canonical self-description.

alias.description: Local filesystem alias for this org — DNS-label-shaped (`themia.pro`, `equanimi.tech`, `autonomous-enterprise`). Matches the `OrgAlias` value object grammar. Drives `<orgs_root>/<alias>/` on disk.

did.description: Optional canonical DID for the org — `did:web:<host>` for domain-anchored orgs that federate. Omitted for local-only orgs that don't (yet) have a public identity. When present, signed envelopes addressed to this org's channels use this DID as the queue owner.

name.description: Human-readable display name (`Themia`, `EquanimiTech`). Defaults to `alias` when omitted at creation time.

description.description: Free-form description of the org — what it does, why it exists in this principal's vault. Decorative; not interpreted by the protocol.

created_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp when this org subscription was first added to the principal's local vault.
